entries.message: Control-W closes the highlighted tab while the recent tab switcher is open, keeping saved and pinned tabs and respecting unsaved changes.
Closing a tab in the recent tab switcher highlights the next preview. When the final preview closes, the window stays open and can return to an older tab.
The recent tab switcher skips tabs closed while a confirmation is pending and preserves a newer tab selection when the final preview closes.
The recent tab switcher stays open while a page asks whether to discard unsaved changes, and resumes after the answer.
